title: Cost of a batch observation program
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, let $J$ be a finite subset of the coordinates $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let $S$ be a finite subset of $J$. For a Boolean target on the sign cube, three prescribed sequences of $m$ cube inputs, and an initial list of rational observations, running the batch program that pairs the fixed-coordinate part of each first input with the free-coordinate parts of the other two, queries the target at both resulting inputs, records the product of their restricted Fourier observations, and charges the prescribed local work has a deterministic output list given by those observations together with the initial list, in its specified order; its cost is $(0,2m,m(2+2n+2|S|+1))$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target function on the n-dimensional sign cube
three prescribed sequences of m cube inputs
